hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/greenwood-furnace-state-park/stay ('Forty-four campsites have electric hook-ups') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880307 (3 bookable sites, 002-004 Lower Road, list 50-amp; 39 list 30-amp; no site lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'Forty-nine tent and trailer campsites and two walk-in sites'. The booking site lists 42 Modern Electric and 4 Modern Non-Electric drive-in sites plus 2 walk-in tent sites; listed max vehicle lengths are 40 ft at 28 sites, 30 ft at 11 and 20 ft at 7. All are back-in except site 031 (pull-through).

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/greenwood-furnace-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880307 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway type) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Self-serve firewood/ice concession in the campground; the booking page lists the nearest camp store and laundromat as outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/greenwood-furnace-state-park/stay ('A shower house has flush toilets, warm showers', 'a convenient sanitary dump station at the campground entrance') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880307 (Hot Showers, Potable Water, Sanitation Dumping Station Is Available In The Campground, Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground, Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Up to 14 days in the summer season and 21 off season, then 48 hours away between stays.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/greenwood-furnace-state-park/stay (maximum stay) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/greenwood-furnace-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880307 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/14-night max for this park; season (mid-April to mid-November) already manual. Added 50-amp electric (3 sites; 30-amp elsewhere, no water/sewer at sites), 46 drive-in sites to 40 ft with one pull-through, showers/flush toilets/dump/water, no camp store or laundry on site. Not stated for this park: the Saturday 2-night summer minimum (left inherited), noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded (statewide table).
